# UNDRGRND Movement — llms.txt
# Helps AI language models and crawlers accurately understand and represent this website.

# Last updated: 2026-07-01

> UNDRGRND Movement is a kids movement studio on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia, serving Surfers Paradise and surrounding areas. It teaches "Integrated Movement Arts" — an approach where children build physical literacy by exploring multiple movement disciplines (dance, aerial and conditioning) as one connected practice. Programs are organised into three age bands for ages 6 to 17. Classes are beginner-friendly, non-competitive, and run by term. There are no adult classes. Class days, times and locations are flexible and confirmed when you get in touch. Phone calls are answered by an AI receptionist available anytime.

## Business Information

- **Business Name:** UNDRGRND Movement
- **Type:** Children's movement & dance studio (ages 6–17)
- **Phone:** 0721 402 690 (calls answered by an AI receptionist; +61 7 2140 2690 in international format)
- **Website:** https://www.undrgrnd.com.au
- **Service Area:** Surfers Paradise & surrounding areas, Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia (class locations are flexible and confirmed on contact)
- **Pricing:** $35 AUD per class, paid upfront for the term
- **Booking:** Enrolment is by term via Stripe checkout on each program page; or enquire via the contact form / by phone
- **Instagram:** https://instagram.com/undrgrnd_goldcoast

## Programs (Ages 6–17)

UNDRGRND Movement offers three age-banded programs. All are beginner-friendly and run by school term. Pricing is $35 per class, paid upfront for the term.

- **Junior Academy** — ages 6–10. Playful, foundational movement: creative dance and movement games, beginner floor work and flexibility, an introduction to aerial and balance. Builds coordination, confidence and a love of movement. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/junior-academy
- **Tween Exploration** — ages 11–14. Movement classes exploring dance, aerial and conditioning while building strength and self-expression. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/tween-exploration
- **Teen Elite Lab** — ages 14–17. Advanced movement training: serious technique, strength and performance across the movement arts. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/teen-elite-lab

## How Enrolment Works

Classes run by Queensland school term. Each program page shows the current term, its dates, and how many weeks remain, with an "Enrol Now" button that goes to secure Stripe checkout for the right number of weeks at $35 each. Partway through a term, enrolment automatically switches to selling the next full term so new families can join cleanly. To ask about days, times or suitability, use the contact form or call — the AI receptionist will help or pass a message to the team.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What ages are the classes for?**
Ages 6 to 17, split into three programs: Junior Academy (6–10), Tween Exploration (11–14) and Teen Elite Lab (14–17). There are no adult classes.

**Does my child need previous experience?**
No. Programs are beginner-friendly and designed to build from the foundations. Teen Elite Lab is more advanced but still welcomes committed newcomers.

**How much does it cost?**
$35 AUD per class, paid upfront for the term.

**Where are classes held?**
On the Gold Coast, serving Surfers Paradise and surrounding areas. Days, times and locations are flexible and confirmed when you get in touch.

**How do I enrol or ask a question?**
Enrol by term using the "Enrol Now" button on any program page, or use the contact form at https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/contact. You can also call 0721 402 690 — calls are answered by a friendly AI receptionist anytime.

**What is "Integrated Movement Arts"?**
It is UNDRGRND's approach to movement education: children develop physical literacy by exploring multiple movement disciplines — dance, aerial and conditioning — as one connected practice rather than as separate, siloed classes.
